description: List the HelloFresh meals picked in recent weeks — the current week and the weeks_back weeks before it — to avoid repeating a recipe. Best effort: each week’s menu is read separately, and weeks that cannot be read are listed with the reason. Weeks before the subscription’s first delivery week had no box (status no_box).

through_week.description: The last week to include, as an ISO week (default: the current week).

weeks_back.description: How many weeks before through_week to include (default 4).

name: hf_recent_picks
